framings.label: Neutral procedural vote report
framings.description: Straight news accounts that report the House blocking or rejecting the impeachment effort, citing the 211-204 tally and GOP leadership's procedural move, with little interpretation.

framings.label: Democratic attendance and leadership failure
framings.description: Frames the outcome around 11 absent Democrats and the narrow seven-vote margin, treating it as a problem for Jeffries and party unity and asking why members missed the vote.

framings.label: Trump and Hegseth vindication narrative
framings.description: Presents the failure as exoneration, quoting Trump's praise of Hegseth as a patriot, his attacks on Massie and Democrats, and Hegseth's dismissal of the effort as a farce comparable to Trump's past impeachments.

framings.label: Not over: effort may return
framings.description: Emphasizes qualifiers such as 'for now' and 'could try again', noting Democrats could revive the impeachment push after the midterms or in January.

framings.label: Iran war and legitimacy of charges
framings.description: Places the impeachment in the context of the Iran war and oversight, with supporters like Ocasio-Cortez and Jeffries calling the articles legitimate while Hegseth and the White House cast it as a policy disagreement or a threat to national security signaling.
